research_routes.source: SkillOps: Managing LLM Agent Skill Libraries as Self-Maintaining Software Ecosystems (arXiv:2605.13716)
research_routes.projection: Skills can be maintained as typed contracts inside an ecosystem graph with explicit utility, compatibility, risk and validation dimensions.
research_routes.rakl_absorption: Treat typed skill contracts and library health as prior art. Extend only with scientific authority envelopes and explicit transition witnesses into target knowledge fibers.

research_routes.route: scientific resource to validated skill compilation
research_routes.source: SkillFoundry: Building Self-Evolving Agent Skill Libraries from Heterogeneous Scientific Resources (arXiv:2604.03964)
research_routes.projection: Scientific repositories, APIs, scripts, notebooks, databases and papers can be compiled into validated skills carrying scope, I/O, environment assumptions, provenance and tests, then repaired, merged or pruned.
research_routes.rakl_absorption: Do not claim scientific-skill mining or validated skill lifecycle as novel. Require RAKL-specific semantic/authority transition maps before such skills can affect canonical research state.

research_routes.source: HASP: Harnessing LLM Agents with Skill Programs (arXiv:2605.17734)
research_routes.projection: Skills can become executable program functions that intervene in failure-prone states and can evolve under validation.
research_routes.rakl_absorption: Executable guardrails are replaceable proposal/execution modules. Their ability to intervene does not grant epistemic authority outside a verified contract.

research_routes.source: SkillSmith: Co-Evolving Skills and Tools for Self-Improving Agent Systems (arXiv:2606.01314)
research_routes.projection: Skills and tools can co-evolve, pairwise complementarity/conflict can guide mutation, and anti-patterns can preserve failure signatures, causal attributions and remedies.
research_routes.rakl_absorption: Treat complementarity/conflict modeling and anti-pattern memory as prior art. Map anti-patterns into RAKL immutable negative method history and require frozen re-entry evidence before supersession.

research_routes.source: S1-NexusAgent: a Self-Evolving Agent Framework for Multidisciplinary Scientific Research (arXiv:2602.01550)
research_routes.projection: Scientific agents can dynamically retrieve large heterogeneous tool sets, isolate sparse subtask context and distill successful trajectories into reusable scientific skills.
research_routes.rakl_absorption: Dynamic retrieval and trajectory-to-skill distillation are routing/memory candidates, not method authority. RAKL should benchmark them as operators under the same fiber contracts and budgets.

research_routes.route: open scientific skill repositories and supply-chain practice
research_routes.projection: Portable scientific skills are installed with explicit provenance metadata and can be version-pinned for reproducibility; the repository warns that skills may execute code and require review.
research_routes.rakl_absorption: Reinforce N029 evaluator/dependency provenance and require source version/dependency identity in every assimilated method contract.

research_routes.route: small routed research skills and archive/review boundaries
research_routes.projection: A modular research workflow can separate engine/application layers, use multi-source fallback and dedup, preserve a read-only raw archive, and enforce reviewer isolation/freeze-before-synthesis rules.
research_routes.rakl_absorption: Keep modular routing, raw-versus-promoted knowledge and review-boundary discipline. Do not inherit fixed scoring weights as universal epistemic priorities.

deduplication_notes: Typed skill contracts are prior art through SkillOps and SkillFoundry; RAKL does not count contract modularity itself as novel.
Validated or self-evolving skill libraries are prior art through SkillFoundry, HASP, EvoSkills and related work.
Dynamic scientific tool retrieval and skill distillation are prior art through S1-NexusAgent and adjacent systems.
Anti-pattern/failure memory is reinforced by SkillSmith and is semantically aligned with RAKL negative-history preservation rather than a new standalone principle.
The retained RAKL contribution is the scientific authority/atlas consequence of assimilation, not skill packaging itself.

retained_semantic_objects.meaning: An imported method operator declares scientific authority it may mint and authority it must not mint; requested scope outside the verified envelope is rejected before shadow testing.
Assimilation requires an explicit, evidence-bearing semantic transition from an external operator output contract into the target RAKL fiber rather than relying on interface resemblance.
A locally valid external method with incompatible assumptions can remain a parallel method chart instead of being forced into one global pipeline or rejected as globally wrong.
A proposed method matching a preserved failed anti-pattern is rejected until separately justified supersession evidence exists; rediscovery under a new name cannot erase prior failure.
